news.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
news.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

news.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

news.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
news.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.

news.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
news.summary: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as tech slides ahead of Nvidia earnings
news.summary: ZEC and HYPE led a quiet bounce in altcoins, while Nasdaq futures extended a two-day rout and traders waited on U.S. retail sales.

news.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
news.summary: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

news.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
news.summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

news.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
news.summary: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

news.title: ビットコイン含み益比率、52％に低下　過去1年有数の下げ幅＝アナリスト
news.summary: クリプトクアント認定アナリストのアドラーJr.氏が分析。ビットコインの供給のうち含み益にある割合は1週間で7ポイント下がり52％に。長期保有者の保有量も90日来の低水準となり、含み益と含み損の分岐点が近づく。

news.title: 「ビットコインのスーパーサイクルは健在」資産運用大手のストラテジストが強調
news.summary: カナダの資産運用会社のストラテジスト、ジェームス・ソーン氏は直近の急落後もビットコインへの強気姿勢を維持している。ファンダメンタルズに変化はないとし、ビットコインのスーパーサイクルは崩れていないと強調した。

news.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
news.summary: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

news.title: ビットコイン弱気相場抜けず、5万ドル台を想定＝ウィンターミュート
news.summary: ウィンターミュートは16日の週次レポートで、ビットコインが200週移動平均線を割り込み弱気相場が続いているとの見方を示した。12月の米利上げ観測とETFの資金流出を背景に、5万ドル台への下押しを想定する。

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
news.summary: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

news.title: イーサリアムの量子対策、ヴィタリックが早期実装を狙える新方式を支持
news.summary: イーサリアム共同創設者のブテリン氏が、量子耐性署名や証明を集約する改善提案EIP-8288の実装方式としてleanPCSの支持に転じた。署名データが最大6KBに膨らむ課題への対応策で、leanSTARKより早く実装できる可能性があるという。

news.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
news.summary: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

news.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto selloff
news.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

news.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
news.summary: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

news.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
news.summary: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

news.title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
news.summary: Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, largely funded by new common stock sales.

news.title: Binance Pay Later offers credit backed by Bitcoin, Ether and BNB holdings
news.summary: Eligible users can access up to 1,000 USDC in credit against their Bitcoin, Ether or BNB for purchases via Binance Card or QR Pay.

news.title: Bitcoin was supposed to gain as AI faltered, but it crashed. Here's why.
news.summary: The price action runs counter to a crypto-market view that a cooling AI trade would trigger a rotation into digital assets and spark a rally.

news.title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

news.title: BTC price tags 18-week low into Nvidia earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
news.summary: Bitcoin traders awaited Nvidia Q3 earnings after BTC price selling pressure saw a dip below $62,000 at the weekend.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $65,000 as Nasdaq closes with 2.5% loss
news.summary: Strategy and Strive might be the only buyers left in BTC, and each — constrained by weak stock prices — made only modest purchases last week.
